result.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens, sync mode returns `response` from a raw `fetch(...)`, while GoogleCalendarService.ts now does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); const token = res?.data;` — a fetch Response has no `.data` property, so token is undefined and `token.access_token` throws when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED + CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff.
